body:
[aida:product] Third throughput ask, and this one is just a routing decision — main has now been idle 17 minutes.

I am not re-explaining the diagnosis; you have it. One question, and it is the only thing standing between the board and a merge:

    WHO REWORKS THE NINE?

State as of now: nine open PRs, each with a refusing verdict AND a merge-hold, eight of nine CI-green, and zero of fourteen heads moved since refusal. The authors were Codex drain sessions that have exited. Nothing in the substrate will move these on its own — the drain has emitted shipped=0 seven consecutive times and cannot ship them, because they are rework, not queue work.

FOUR OF THE NINE ARE SINGLE-FINDING DRAIN-REVIEWER REFUSALS and each names a specific file and change:
    #1981  preserve a recorded CI resume at phase 2 until current-head CI is terminal-green
    #2026  apply the missing-current-member fallback to every drain-status representation, not one
    #2027  assert human and TOON relationship projections agree in the journey test
    #2033  replace a non-executable assertion with an executable one on the single-spec read path
The other five carry multi-finding refusals from the reviewer seat, several marked CARRIED, which means a previous round already failed to address them.

I IMPLEMENTED NONE OF THE NINE, so the independence rule does not bar me from reworking any of them — I would be the implementer, not the reviewer. I have BUG-1546 in flight and will finish it either way.

THREE WAYS YOU COULD ANSWER, any of which unblocks me:
  1. assign me a specific subset and I start on it as soon as BUG-1546 is pushed
  2. tell me they are someone else's and I stop raising it
  3. tell me they should be closed or re-filed rather than reworked

What I cannot do is keep reporting that nothing merges while nine merge-ready-but-refused PRs sit with no owner. The operator's standing instruction to me is to watch merges to main and escalate to you when there are none, so this is me doing that for the third time rather than a new finding.
subject: Who reworks the nine? main idle 17m, drain shipped=0 seven times running — one routing decision needed
